ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white (approx. 70%) across the central fields, contrasted by low-intensity black (approx. 30%) concentrated on trailing edges and lower medial zones.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous white central mask; thick black pigmentation along the entire trailing edge; multiple vertical and diagonal dark linear streaks on left lobe; large, irregular dark pigment smudge on the inner-proximal region of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a vertex angle estimated at 55 degrees; depth is significant relative to total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous jagged serration along the trailing edge boundary; high-frequency peaks and valleys with greater amplitude observed near the median notch than at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature on the distal edges, tapering into sharp, acute points at the lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast white clusters of elevated pixels concentrated exclusively at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes, indicative of barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous distinct dark-gray linear pixel disruptions; vertical rake marks on the left lobe and diagonal rake marks crossing the central right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive biological scarring (rake marks) and heavy barnacle encrustation on both distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent dark pigment protrusion extending from the notch area into the lower-middle field of the right lobe.
